title: Design Front Middle Back Queue
problemStatement: Design a queue that supports insertion and deletion at the front, middle, and back. The queue must support: pushFront(x) pushMiddle(x) pushBack(x) popFront() popMiddle() popBack() If the queue is empty, every pop operation returns -1. Process a sequence of operations and print the results of every pop operation.
output: Print the result of every pop operation.
